sentences.en: You were a warden in a prison for ten years.
sentences.zh: 你在监狱里当了十年看守。

sentences.en: The wardens and guards looked at each other in surprise.
sentences.zh: 警卫和看守们惊讶地对视着。

sentences.en: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
sentences.zh: 骚乱开始时只有一个人在值班。

senses.zh: 看守人；典狱官；区长；学监 Warden(有时用warden )华登冬梨(供煮食)
